structs.notes: Init, AddSystem, Release, Save, UpdateSounds, UpdateBoneMapCache, GetGlobalTintColor and AllocateMarkSpawnData were read (decompile or scan). The first pass's offsets hold: from 294968 to 313744 the Replay layout is the game-test layout shifted by -768, with the sound lists shrinking by 256 B per list (64 -> 56 B elements); the IDA layout has every member after 294968 at its game-test offset and is wrong by that shift. The size is not resolved: the bounds are 564528 (counter, plausible) to 2501248 (IDA), and the two Replay tail accesses (1366320 table, 2499548 destructor) each depend on a membership question that the code does not settle. Child ParticleManager__Particle_SoundData stays 56 bytes (CONFIRMED by 0x700 memsets and 32-element list stride). Nothing was written to IDA. Renames: none proven.
